definitions.text: One of the somites (arthromeres) that make up the thorax of Arthropods. Packard.
One of the thoracic legs of Arthropods.

A meteorite, or similar rude stone artificially shaped, held sacred or worshiped as of divine origin. All the evidence goes to prove that these menhirs are bætuli, i. e., traditional and elementary images of the deity. I. Gonino (Perrot & Chipiez).
